strict_target: 15/15 workloads strictly smaller and faster to create than ZIP/Deflate and solid Zstd-19

three_anchor_depth1.reason: Exhaustive three-anchor search is not near the strict boundary; it is dramatically larger than both shipping PrefixGraph and Zstd-19. Metadata or selector tuning cannot plausibly rescue this representation branch.

member_local_existing_member_forest.interpretation: Exact all-member pairwise prefix costs contain large theoretical cyclic headroom, but the minimum acyclic existing-member forest must retain two costly direct roots and closes only 70 bytes of the shipping-to-Zstd gap. More existing-member dependency edges are therefore low-value; the next test must change root ownership rather than add graph search.

combined_hostile_review.strongest_surviving_self_critique: The pairwise raw-prefix codec still shows impossible-best headroom, so these receipts do not retire all resemblance-aware representations. They retire global-anchor expansion as the primary route and show that ordinary acyclic existing-member roots consume essentially all realizable headroom.
combined_hostile_review.next_decisive_test: locality-bounded cluster-owned physical roots that jointly encode members, preserving <=8 MiB decode units and <=8x decoded-context amplification before any speed/productization claim
